stem: Which situation can be represented by 17.35x > 624.60?

options.label: F
options.text: A waitress had received a $17.35 tip. This brought her total in tips to more than $624.60. How much money in tips did she have before the $17.35 tip?

options.label: G
options.text: Brianda made a deposit of $17.35 into a savings account. This brought the total in her savings account to $624.60. How much money did she have in this savings account before she made the deposit?

options.label: H
options.text: A dozen tamales cost $17.35 including tax. How many dozen tamales can a customer buy with $624.60?

options.label: J
options.text: Darren earns $17.35 per hour at his job. How many hours does he need to work in order to earn more than $624.60?
